prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1093; do not mention it.)
text:
This is a synthetic test document. The patient presented for evaluation following a motor vehicle collision in which another vehicle sideswiped them while they were changing lanes. The patient reported neck pain, stiffness, and headache beginning shortly after the impact, with pain rated as moderate and worse with rotation of the head. On examination, cervical range of motion was reduced in all planes, with tenderness over the paraspinal muscles and upper trapezius. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, and there were no signs of fracture or instability on the assessment performed.

The working diagnosis is acute cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder. Treatment at the first visit consisted of gentle range-of-motion exercises, application of a cold pack, and an over-the-counter analgesic, along with instruction to avoid heavy lifting and to limit prolonged neck positioning.

At the second visit, the patient reported modest improvement in headache frequency, though neck stiffness persisted, particularly on waking. Range of motion had improved somewhat, and tenderness was less pronounced. The plan going forward includes continued home exercises, a gradual return to normal activity as tolerated, and reassessment if symptoms fail to resolve within the expected recovery period.
